title: Time Series Forecasting via Reasoning: A Slow-Thinking Approach with Reinforcement Fine-Tuned LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2506.10630v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: To advance time series forecasting (TSF), various methods have been proposed to improve prediction accuracy, evolving from statistical techniques to data-driven deep learning architectures. Despite their effectiveness, most existing methods still adhere to a fast thinking paradigm-relying on extracting historical patterns and mapping them to future values as their core modeling philosophy, lacking an explicit thinking process that incorporates intermediate time series reasoning. Meanwhile, emerging slow-thinking LLMs (e.g., OpenAI-o1) have shown remarkable multi-step reasoning capabilities, offering an alternative way to overcome these issues. However, prompt engineering alone presents several limitations - including high computational cost, privacy risks, and limited capacity for in-depth domain-specific time series reasoning. translated_title: 基于推理的时间序列预测：一种采用强化微调大语言模型的慢思考方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.10630v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：为了推进时间序列预测（TSF），研究者们提出了多种方法来提高预测精度，这些方法从统计技术发展到数据驱动的深度学习架构。尽管这些方法有效，但大多数现有方法仍遵循“快速思考”范式——其核心建模理念依赖于提取历史模式并将其映射到未来值，缺乏包含中间时间序列推理的显式思考过程。与此同时，新兴的“慢思考”大语言模型（如OpenAI-o1）展示了显著的多步推理能力，为克服这些问题提供了另一种途径。然而，仅靠提示工程存在若干局限性——包括高计算成本、隐私风险以及针对特定领域时间序列深入推理的能力有限。为解决这些局限性，一种更有前景的方法是训练大语言模型以发展慢思考能力。
tldr: 本文提出通过强化微调大语言模型来培养其慢思考能力，以显式推理过程克服传统时间序列预测方法缺乏中间推理的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes training large language models with reinforcement fine-tuning to develop slow-thinking capabilities, using explicit reasoning to overcome the limitation of traditional time series forecasting methods that lack intermediate reasoning.
